name: jabol-monorepo
description: Just A Bunch Of Links — self-hostable JSON-driven link directory (workspace root).

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @jabol/core build && concurrently -k -n core,server,spa -c green,blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @jabol/core dev" "pnpm --filter @jabol/server dev" "pnpm --filter @jabol/client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @jabol/core build && pnpm --filter @jabol/client build && pnpm --filter @jabol/server build
